p5/esc1013:0.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:0.text: It keeps us up at night because we know she isn't sleeping.  Worse part is there is nothing we can do to help her.

p5/esc1013:1.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:1.text: Hi! It seems someone in the family is having sleeping issues. Correct me if I am wrong

p5/esc1013:10.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:10.text: We do the same for her, and it helps for a couple hours but then she's up again.

p5/esc1013:11.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:11.text: Some people says giving green tea helps in cold.

p5/esc1013:12.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:12.text: Really, I'll have to try that. Thank you!

p5/esc1013:13.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:13.text: Taking steamed shower helps in cold as well. You can try that too. I will pray for her speedy recovery.

p5/esc1013:14.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:14.text: Thank you so much.  You have been very helpful.

p5/esc1013:15.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:15.text: I feel much better after talking with you.

p5/esc1013:16.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:16.text: I hope you have a good rest of the day.

p5/esc1013:17.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:17.text: Mt best wishes are there with you. Be positive she will sleep well and recover soon.

p5/esc1013:18.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:18.text: I will. And I pray that she will.

p5/esc1013:2.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:2.text: My daughter is really sick and its causing her to have trouble sleeping.  Not sure what to do.

p5/esc1013:3.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:3.text: Sorry to here about it. It must be hard for you to see her in trouble.

p5/esc1013:4.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:4.text: May I ask What happen to her.

p5/esc1013:5.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:5.text: It is.  She's miserable, and it's causing us to not sleep as well.

p5/esc1013:6.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:6.text: It's nothing serious, common cold, but she has asthma so whenever she gets sick, it causes labored breathing.

p5/esc1013:7.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:7.text: I can feel how stressed you are right now but she will recover fast.

p5/esc1013:8.speaker: seeker
p5/esc1013:8.text: I know she will, I always lack sleep whenever she's not feeling well.  I wish I could be sick for her.

p5/esc1013:9.speaker: supporter
p5/esc1013:9.text: When my kid have cold, I nebulize her and later it make her sleep well

p5/esc62:10.speaker: seeker
p5/esc62:10.text: Yeah and the company is planning layoff for some of the staffs

p5/esc62:11.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:11.text: How do you know that layoffs are coming?

p5/esc62:12.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:12.text: Why not try to work for Uber or Lyft to supplement your income?

p5/esc62:13.speaker: seeker
p5/esc62:13.text: They sent circular to all staffs

p5/esc62:14.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:14.text: What did it state? I am sorry to hear the news.

p5/esc62:15.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:15.text: Have you looked at updating your resume and looking on job boards?

p5/esc62:16.speaker: seeker
p5/esc62:16.text: No I think I will just do that now may be it will help

p5/esc62:17.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:17.text: That is a great comment. Being pro-active and looking for similar jobs can help.

p5/esc62:19.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:19.text: It' good to take initiative and start looking for other sources of income.

p5/esc62:2.speaker: seeker
p5/esc62:2.text: I don't even know, because I am not happy

p5/esc62:20.speaker: seeker
p5/esc62:20.text: I believe it work if I try.

p5/esc62:21.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:21.text: I usually search job boards.  It is what I have dine in the past.

p5/esc62:22.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:22.text: It is important to believe in yourself.

p5/esc62:25.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:25.text: What other feelings and thoughts can I discern for you?

p5/esc62:26.speaker: seeker
p5/esc62:26.text: I can't think of any now thanks for being there for me

p5/esc62:28.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:28.text: I think that I can be here to answer.

p5/esc62:4.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:4.text: I have been sad at times, but I listen to pleasant music.

p5/esc62:5.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:5.text: When have you started feeling sad?

p5/esc62:6.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:6.text: I had fear of losing my job at times.

p5/esc62:7.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:7.text: I suggest doing stress relieving tasks

p5/esc62:8.speaker: seeker
p5/esc62:8.text: I can't think of that of now, because last three month a go pay cut and nest month payoff

p5/esc62:9.speaker: supporter
p5/esc62:9.text: Can you repeat that? You had a pay cut in the last three months?

p5/esc652:0.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:0.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?

p5/esc652:1.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:1.text: Hi, I'm feeling really anxious today.

p5/esc652:10.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:10.text: I know that's very difficult. And no doubt why you're here working for crumbs.

p5/esc652:11.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:11.text: It's why I'm here as well.

p5/esc652:12.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:12.text: Yeah, trying to make ends meet wherever I can

p5/esc652:13.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:13.text: I've been also trying to do uber as well but everyone is doing it also

p5/esc652:14.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:14.text: I know it's a difficult time. Yes Uber is definitely overrun right now. Have you taken any time out to address your anxiety so it doesn't become more serious?

p5/esc652:15.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:15.text: I don't know what I can do. I've been trying to keep busy. And I can't afford a therapist or anything like that.

p5/esc652:16.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:16.text: Yes, that's definitely an expense you can't afford right now. But are you familiar with the concept of controlled breathing to help reduce or relieve anxiety?

p5/esc652:18.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:18.text: What am I supposed to do? Just breathe in and out a lot?

p5/esc652:19.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:19.text: Not exactly. Controlled breathing is more of getting yourself into a quiet room. Closing your eyes, and purposely and intently focusing on your breathing. Slowly breathe in for a count of 5, then slowly exhale for a count of 5. Repeat this process for approximately 10 minute. It will help your stress levels and help regulate your heart rate!

p5/esc652:2.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:2.text: What has made you feel anxious?

p5/esc652:20.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:20.text: Oh I didn't know that. No, I haven't tried that. Does it really work?

p5/esc652:21.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:21.text: I've been using it myself over the past 3 months and it most definitely helps! But it's absolutely imperative to clear your mind and have complete quiet.

p5/esc652:22.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:22.text: ok I can try it I guess

p5/esc652:24.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:24.text: No problem. I hope this gives you some relief! Stay strong!

p5/esc652:26.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:26.text: My final piece of advice would be to set aside time that is specified where nothing negative is discussed. No politics, no bills, nothing anxiety producing for you. It's probably best if this time is within an hour of your bedtime becuase anxiety is not conducive to a good night's sleep.

p5/esc652:28.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:28.text: No problem. Take care. Wishing you well on your situation.

p5/esc652:3.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:3.text: Yesterday my company laid off 10% of the workforce and another 10% got furloughed.

p5/esc652:4.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:4.text: I'm afraid I might be in the next round.

p5/esc652:5.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:5.text: I am very sorry to hear that. I am currently in a situation where furloughs are greatly affecting my family as well.

p5/esc652:7.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:7.text: The problem is, I am right now the only breadwinner in the family. My wife was laid off three months ago

p5/esc652:8.speaker: supporter
p5/esc652:8.text: Are you given specifics on time of furlough?

p5/esc652:9.speaker: seeker
p5/esc652:9.text: No, it's basically until things get better.

p5/esc968:0.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:0.text: Hey there, what's going on today?

p5/esc968:1.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:1.text: Hello. It is a fine day, how about yourself?

p5/esc968:10.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:10.text: My father and I had a fight 2 years ago and haven't spoke since.

p5/esc968:11.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:11.text: The same happened to me, and then my father passed away. If there is anything I can say, is to swallow pride and cherish the moments you have on earth together. What was the fight over?

p5/esc968:12.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:12.text: Yeah I am afraid that these things can happen. It was only over material things.

p5/esc968:13.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:13.text: That was my next question, what the fight was over. Do you think he would be open to mending things?

p5/esc968:14.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:14.text: It is weird because I called him out for being manipulative so this is his defense.

p5/esc968:15.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:15.text: Usually when people feel singled out, they only have a few mechanisms. Unfortunately, most people tend to run away instead of fixing things. It tends to be the easier option.

p5/esc968:16.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:16.text: I would likely take advantage of an opportunity to be the bigger person.

p5/esc968:17.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:17.text: When you try to fix things, just remember that this is his method. I wouldn't hold back on what you have to say, but just word it so that he doesn't feel the need to flee.

p5/esc968:19.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:19.text: It is HIS responsibility as a parent to want to fix things, but you are also being the bigger person here. I applaud you and hope that he is receptive.

p5/esc968:2.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:2.text: It really is! I am just taking in the fresh air in the backyard.

p5/esc968:20.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:20.text: I hope so too, but the opportunity seems tenuous

p5/esc968:21.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:21.text: How did you guys leave it?

p5/esc968:23.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:23.text: Ha, well after two years, feelings had to have changed. Even a little. Does he live nearby?

p5/esc968:24.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:24.text: Yeah someday. I think I will have to try you know. THanks for the advice.

p5/esc968:4.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:4.text: Thanks! What is going on in your neck of the woods?

p5/esc968:5.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:5.text: Sort of stuck inside trying to make a dime but it is alright.

p5/esc968:6.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:6.text: Yeah great minds think alike.. do you do anything else for work?

p5/esc968:7.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:7.text: Looking for a good job right now.

p5/esc968:8.speaker: seeker
p5/esc968:8.text: I wanted to talk about a personal issue I have been having, though.

p5/esc968:9.speaker: supporter
p5/esc968:9.text: Okay, you know I'm here for you. Talk to me, what's happening?

p5/p5_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:0.text: Hey Charles, I'm here for you. How are you holding up after everything with Emily?

p5/p5_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:1.text: Hi, it's been really challenging. Seeing Emily in the hospital is something no parent wants.

p5/p5_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:10.text: Margaret sounds like a wonderful mother, but it's important for both of you to care for yourselves too. How are you supporting each other?

p5/p5_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:11.text: We're trying to talk things out and give each other breaks. It's a work in progress.

p5/p5_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:12.text: That's a healthy approach. It's so important to lean on each other and take things one day at a time.

p5/p5_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:13.text: Yeah, some days are better than others. Getting back to a routine helps, but the worry is constant.

p5/p5_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:14.text: That constant worry must be exhausting. Do you have any outlets or activities to help manage it?

p5/p5_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:15.text: I try to go for a run in the mornings. It's not much, but it clears my head for a bit.

p5/p5_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:16.text: Exercise is great for stress relief. Even small moments of peace are valuable. You're doing your best, and that matters.

p5/p5_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:17.text: Thank you. It's good to hear that. It's just hard not to feel guilty for needing time away.

p5/p5_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:18.text: Taking care of yourself isn't selfish; it's necessary. Being at your best helps you support Emily and Margaret even better.

p5/p5_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:19.text: You're right. I need to remember that. It's a delicate balance, but we're getting there.

p5/p5_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:2.text: I completely understand. It must be really hard to see her go through this. How is she doing now?

p5/p5_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:20.text: It sounds like you and Margaret are doing an incredible job under tough circumstances. Keep leaning on each other. You're not alone.

p5/p5_conv_1:21.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:21.text: Thanks for listening. It really helps to talk things out and know someone understands.

p5/p5_conv_1:22.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:22.text: Anytime, Charles. I'm here whenever you need to talk. You're doing great, just keep taking those steps forward.

p5/p5_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:3.text: She's stable now, thankfully. But every time she has an episode, it takes a toll on us, especially Margaret.

p5/p5_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:4.text: I'm relieved to hear Emily is stable. The stress must be immense for you both. What's been the most difficult part?

p5/p5_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:5.text: I think it's the feeling of helplessness. We do everything we can, but it feels like we're just waiting for the next attack.

p5/p5_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:6.text: That sounds overwhelming, Charles. Feeling helpless is tough. Have you found anything that helps ease that feeling, even a little?

p5/p5_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:7.text: Talking to someone helps a bit. And knowing we're following the doctor’s advice, but the uncertainty lingers.

p5/p5_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p5/p5_conv_1:8.text: It's good that you're reaching out and following medical guidance. It's okay to feel uncertain; anyone would in your shoes.

p5/p5_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_1:9.text: Thanks, I appreciate that. Margaret tries to be strong for Emily, but I can see it's wearing her down too.

p5/p5_conv_6:0.speaker: seeker
p5/p5_conv_6:0.text: Hey, just needed someone to talk to. It's been a rough week.

d1d63b65333373bf593e906e4f2ead1ae5880ad3.head: MP
d1d63b65333373bf593e906e4f2ead1ae5880ad3.statement: interested in accessible anxiety relief techniques

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Oh I didn't know that. No, I haven't tried that. Does it really work?

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: ok I can try it I guess

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I don't know what I can do. I've been trying to keep busy. And I can't afford a therapist or anything like that.

abca2b73826140fe566e548aaad009c1f156864a.head: ME
abca2b73826140fe566e548aaad009c1f156864a.statement: seeker felt better after talking with supporter

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I feel much better after talking with you.

93251ddd266745602037c6221718e928fefccd08.head: ME
93251ddd266745602037c6221718e928fefccd08.statement: finds relief in talking about struggles with supportive listener

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Talking to someone helps a bit. And knowing we're following the doctor’s advice, but the uncertainty lingers.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thanks for listening. It really helps to talk things out and know someone understands.

1b3cb5cebc9a0f2561bc6814abcb4f4fba9afddc.head: ME
1b3cb5cebc9a0f2561bc6814abcb4f4fba9afddc.statement: seeker expressed willingness to try controlled breathing for anxiety

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: ok I can try it I guess

394c17bd69e662136b3bd74dd2a01730fc615587.statement: seeker started trying to do Uber work to make ends meet
